package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for cross_repository_write_flow_without_shared_uow_boundary: Service methods coordinating several repositories with no explicit shared transaction or consistency boundary.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type OrderRepository struct{ db *sql.DB }
type LedgerRepository struct{ db *sql.DB }

func (or *OrderRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, amount float64) error { return nil }
func (lr *LedgerRepository) RecordDebit(ctx context.Context, amount float64) error { return nil }

func ProcessOrder(ctx context.Context, amount float64, orderRepo *OrderRepository, ledgerRepo *LedgerRepository) error {
	if err := orderRepo.Create(ctx, amount); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("cross_repository_write_flow_without_shared_uow_boundary: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ledgerRepo.RecordDebit(ctx, amount); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("cross_repository_write_flow_without_shared_uow_boundary: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}
